content:
As you may know, mathlib was created in 2017 --- so will turn ten years old next year. This should be celebrated. The Mathlib Initiative is organizing a big anniversary conference for the broader mathlib community: mark your calendars from July 19 -- 23, 2027 (most likely in Europe).
There will be opportunity to look back at the early history, celebrate what was achieved, marvel at the breadth what is possible today and look ahead at times to come. We are also planning with an unconference-style all-hands for experienced mathlib contributors. Further details (including the specifics of the registration process) will be announced in due course; stay tuned for more information.

Johan Commelin and Michael Rothgang
